name: Printify
description: Independent SSMA printify module; simulator/live mode and authority remain explicit.

catalogObservationMaxAgeSeconds.description: Maximum age of a successful cached external catalog observation. A current observation grants no stock, price, fulfillment or production authority.

catalogReadEnabled.description: Permit governed read-only access to successful cached catalog observations. This does not enable order import, fulfillment or production.

mcpTools.name: printify_connection
mcpTools.description: Read paginated authorized printify connection evidence; credentials and personal information excluded.

mcpTools.name: printify_product
mcpTools.description: Read paginated authorized printify product evidence; credentials and personal information excluded.

mcpTools.name: printify_job
mcpTools.description: Read paginated authorized printify job evidence; credentials and personal information excluded.

mcpTools.name: printify_shop
mcpTools.description: Read only the configured authorized shop identity and source channel, without credentials.

mcpTools.name: printify_exceptions
mcpTools.description: Read-only connector conditions; uncertain provider outcomes require reconciliation.
